slides.text:
OpenAI just released an <accent>official Codex plugin for Claude Code</accent>.

It's not a replacement. It's a power combo.

Here's what it does, how to set it up, and why you should care.

slides.heading: The <accent>Benchmarks</accent>
slides.caption: Claude Opus 4.6 vs GPT-5.4 — core coding benchmarks. GPT-5.4 leads in most, but Opus holds its own on HumanEval.

slides.heading: Claude Code <accent>Pitfalls</accent>
slides.caption: Claude Code over-engineers, hits token limits fast, and drifts on long runs. Codex fills exactly these gaps.

slides.heading: Codex <accent>Weaknesses</accent>
slides.caption: Codex needs detailed prompts, produces flat output, and uses rigid naming. Claude Code handles this side perfectly.

slides.heading: How to <accent>Set It Up</accent>
slides.caption: Install via /plugin marketplace. Supports /codex:rescue, /codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review and more.

slides.heading: The <accent>/codex:review</accent> Command
slides.caption: Run a Codex review on your current work or branch. Runs in the background — Claude keeps coding while Codex reviews.

slides.heading: Live Demo: <accent>Game Build</accent>
slides.caption: Claude Code builds a 2D roguelike dungeon crawler. Codex tab active in the sidebar. Both agents working in parallel.

slides.heading: The Game <accent>Actually Runs</accent>
slides.caption: Fully playable roguelike with combat, inventory, minimap — built in minutes with Claude Code + Codex combo.

slides.heading: Adversarial Review <accent>in Action</accent>
slides.caption: Codex adversarial review runs in the background. Claude checks /codex:status — review finds real game-breaking bugs.

slides.heading: The <accent>Power Workflow</accent>
items: Claude keeps working on the next task
Feed Codex findings back to Claude
Claude fixes the bugs Codex found
